items.title: Numerical intersection multiplicities factor through an effective Cartier divisor: L_1...L_d.Z equals L_2...L_d.D when L_1 restricted to Z is O_Z(D)
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter varieties.tex, section on numerical intersections

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma reduces a numerical intersection number (L_1 ... L_d . Z) on a proper d-dimensional closed subscheme Z to the divisor intersection (L_2 ... L_d . D), assuming L_1|_Z is the invertible sheaf O_Z(D) of an effective Cartier divisor D. The proof replaces X by Z, uses the short exact sequence 0 -> L_1^{-1} -> O_X -> O_D -> 0, expresses both sides through the Hilbert polynomials P and Q of the L_i, and shows P - P(shifted) = Q; the coefficient comparison uses that the total degree of P is at most d (proof lines 10554-10576). H2: the polynomial-difference translation and the coefficient argument are the non-routine steps.
